slack.name: Get Channel Messages
slack.description: Get recent messages from a Slack conversation.

channelId.description: The Slack conversation or channel ID.

limit.description: The maximum number of messages to return.

cursor.description: The Slack pagination cursor from a previous page. Omit for the first page.

oldest.description: Only return messages after this Slack timestamp, for example '1700000000.123456'. The message at exactly this timestamp is included only when inclusive is true.

latest.description: Only return messages before this Slack timestamp. Defaults to now. The message at exactly this timestamp is included only when inclusive is true.

inclusive.description: Include messages whose timestamp equals oldest or latest. Slack ignores this unless one of those bounds is set.

includeRaw.description: When true, each returned message also carries the untouched Slack record under raw, including its blocks, attachments, files and message metadata. Defaults to false.

input_schema.description: Input parameters for reading Slack conversation history.

gmail.name: Update Draft
gmail.description: Update a Gmail draft while preserving omitted fields, attachments, CID inline images, and reply headers. Supply replyToMessageId or a different threadId to rebuild the reply association; this additionally requires mailbox read access. A reply draft's subject must match its reply target, ignoring Re: prefixes. Omit body to preserve existing MIME body alternatives; supply body to replace them with one text or HTML body. Omit attachments to preserve them, supply a list to replace all attachments and inline images, or [] to remove them. The draft ID stays stable, but the message ID changes on replacement.

body.description: Replacement body. Omit to preserve all existing text and HTML alternatives; an empty string clears the body.

messageBody.description: Alias for the replacement body. Omit both body fields to preserve existing MIME body alternatives.

isHtml.description: Whether the replacement body is HTML. Omit to inherit the existing body type (HTML when an HTML alternative exists). Set false for plain text or true for HTML. Requires body or messageBody.
